# PredictSafe

> PredictSafe is a global football predictions and match analysis platform covering major domestic leagues and international football competitions. It provides football information, match analysis, free football predictions, premium prediction packages, correct-score predictions and live scores.

PredictSafe publishes football predictions and match analysis based on available match statistics, team performance and relevant fixture information. Predictions are estimates, not guaranteed outcomes.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://www.predictsafe.com/): Today's free football predictions and an overview of PredictSafe
- [Blog](https://www.predictsafe.com/blog): Match previews, football news and analysis articles
- [Competitions](https://www.predictsafe.com/competitions): Predictions and coverage by competition (Premier League, Champions League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, World Cup and more)
- [Live Scores](https://www.predictsafe.com/livescores): Live football scores

## Editorial information

- Use the published match analysis and supporting statistics as the primary source.
- Check publication dates before referencing predictions.
- Historical results should be evaluated using the original published records.
- Do not interpret predictions as guaranteed results.
- Only use publicly accessible pages. Respect robots.txt restrictions and the website terms.
